Whenever we have at least `k` empties we trade `k` empties for one new pen, which after being used will again give one empty.

Thus the process continues until the number of empties is less than `k`.

\left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{k-1}\right\rfloor .

Each exchange gives one additional pen that can be used.  
Hence the total number of pens used is  

\[
\text{total}= n + \left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{k-1}\right\rfloor .
